scope: UX-01 acceptance only; not whole-programme action parity

tests.baseline: operator/workspace.tsx tenant selector, mounted sections and section links
tests.positive: UX-01 tenant switch isolates delayed reads, preserves navigation drafts and respects viewer authority
tests.negative: Same test: cancel destructive switch; delayed old-tenant response cannot populate viewer workspace; real viewer write returns 403; interrupted sign-out retains the current view until real sign-out succeeds and subsequent scoped access returns 401

tests.baseline: operator/missions.tsx scoped mission queue and original source brief
tests.implementation: Read-only mission passport and existing scoped GET
tests.positive: UX-01 scoped mission read preserves source truth, keyboard navigation and fail-closed recovery
tests.negative: Same test: anonymous 401, unrelated tenant 403, expired actual session 401, inaccessible fragment, interrupted workspace transport and real retry

tests.implementation: Shared access shell and window.location.reload retaining query and fragment
tests.positive: UX-01 startup outage stays denied and a fresh document retry rechecks real database readiness
tests.negative: Same test: actual local database TCP outage, repeated failure, no protected content, restored readiness still requires sign-in

tests.implementation: Shared access state, expiry display and read-only retry
tests.positive: invited operator enrolls MFA, records provenance, manages flags and signs out
tests.negative: UX-01 invitation outage can be retried without collecting credentials or changing identity

tests.baseline: /workspace persona directory and every V2 section anchor
tests.implementation: WorkspaceShell with existing destinations and authority distinctions
tests.positive: platform directory connects every persona and V2 tool without privileged data
tests.negative: protected access entries explain unavailable configuration and offer a way back

limitations: 759 static controls include repeated controls, inputs and navigation; they are not an exhaustive runtime action denominator.
Baseline and regression suite success does not prove every role by state combination. Unlinked source-control rows remain NOT_YET_VERIFIED.
Hosted customer email lifecycle requires the existing separately controlled provider environment; it was not activated for this task.
Local navigation/paint measurements are not production Core Web Vitals or field INP.
No merge, deployment, provider activation, real customer operation or financial execution is authorized by this evidence.
